Import and set environment variables from .env file

USAGE
  $ netlify env:import [options] <fileName>

ARGUMENTS
  fileName                    .env file to import

OPTIONS
  --filter <app>              For monorepos, specify the name of the
                              application to run the command in
  -h, --help                  display help for command
  --json                      Output environment variables as JSON
  -r, --replace-existing      Replace all existing variables instead of merging
                              them with the current ones (default: false)
  --debug                     Print debugging information
  --auth <token>              Netlify auth token - can be used to run this
                              command without logging in
  -s, --site <name-or-id>     A project name or ID to target
